full_judgment: 3. The respondents hereof as the plaintiffs filed the Admiralty Suit praying for decree for immediate return of 311 pieces of containers owned by the plaintiff No.1 and also for compensation. The plaintiffs also prayed for an order of interim injunction restringing the defendants front disposing of the suit containers. It has been contended amongst others, that the suit containers were leased out by the plaintiff No.1 to their agent proforma defendant Nos. 2 and 3 as per terms of lease agreement, which however has been terminated with effect from 5.1.2009 and accordingly the plaintiff No.1 demanded return of the containers lying with the defendant No.1 without success and that the cause of action arose for the suit as the defendant No.1 denied return of the said containers on the ground of non-payment of its dues for storing the containers.
